name: @game-hub/game-russianrailroads
description: Russian Railroads (Ultimate Railroads) as a single in-workspace game package — the Track D pilot. Four subpath exports over TypeScript source: ./engine (pure rules core), ./module (backend GameModule), ./client (UI GameClient), ./bot (AI policies, stubbed until RR10). Depends only on @game-hub/kernel (+ React for ./client).
